first_run.limitations: finite helper-induced group OOM; fixture dies with group, so peer-observed socket closure, post-OOM MCP reply and native-client behavior are not measured

retained_run.limitations: finite helper-induced group OOM; fixture dies with group, so peer-observed socket closure, post-OOM MCP reply and native-client behavior are not measured

cleanup: No matching namespace or /etc/netns directory remained after either run. Each exact transient user unit was stopped and reset.
scope: One approved guarded_fetch was pending after a controlled HTTP fixture wrote its first response byte. Helper allocations triggered OOMPolicy=kill in the 64-MiB no-swap owned group; systemd reported oom-kill and no group process survived. A fresh limited group served MCP after cleanup.
limitations: The HTTP fixture and server die together; this does not directly observe peer socket closure, a post-OOM MCP response or client recovery in the original session. It is a finite local route-free namespace/cgroup test, not native-client, sustained-load, arbitrary victim-selection or automatic-restart evidence. Hosted CI does not run this user-systemd/namespace probe.
